numerics: Existing exact binary64-input WLS with rounded gradient outputs.
Auxiliary G_W accumulates its combined exponent exactly before one binary64 rounding, existing math.exp and positive floor; retain the documented far-negative floor branch.
Round eta*W_base once as existing mobility; nonfinite or nonpositive results reject, including mobility underflow to zero.
Accumulate each full reference potential exactly from rounded W_base and declared site outputs, then round once; no edgewise partial rounding or initializer gauge projection.
Use rounded potential and rounded mobility, accumulate each incidence difference/product exactly and round flux once; signed underflow may become canonical zero, unlike positive mobility.

Final G_W combines original unfloored alpha/beta channels and rounded J_ref gamma channel before one exponent rounding. No rounded-E addition, log(W_base), floored-product shortcut or extra bootstrap pass.
Retain representable subnormals; intermediate potential/flux/exp range failures reject with typed stage/disposition. No clipping, log-domain replacement or fallback current.
Existing math.exp is not a new cross-platform correctly-rounded guarantee; retain source/environment and input/output identities without machine-local paths.
identity_and_restoration: Static policy/numerical/recipe identities precede complete target profile, then output-bearing current/reset invocation records, then migration evidence; no identity cycle or new persistent coordinate.

Each invocation binds role, complete target inputs, recipes, policy/numerical identities and resulting W. Derived intermediates must be recomputed if retained; matching claimed flux or hash is not production provenance.
The closed payload and release applicability must be specified before runtime. Old explicit-flux records retain their meaning and are not silently upgraded or rehashed.
Restoration checks archived crossing inputs and initialized endpoints, not a fresh-initializer constraint on subsequently ordinarily evolved W; external-history trust ceiling remains.
lifecycle: Apply one policy independently to current/reset target C and context. Identical operands give identical numeric outputs despite different record roles; do not manufacture a reset-only failure using caller-supplied unequal fluxes.

Preserve current/reset C, charge target and clock on same-graph C-to-A. Receipt history-free A W construction separately from source C carrier loss; initialize target A persistent carriers to zero, never reinterpret source C carrier history.
Readmit both complete final targets using existing OS/CI/PC/CI+PC/RG2b owners; RG2b state/section admission is not next-beat eligibility.
No continuity, resource repair, clock advance, ordinary W write or carrier/formation beat. Publish authority, references, archives, receipts and commit identity atomically after all checks.

Typed semantic failures preserve stage/disposition; unexpected programmer exceptions propagate. Preserve accepted F1/F2 known/repeated-state checks and lawful unreceipted assignment without forced adjacency.

attributes.normative_equation_or_contract: For every receipt r in commit group k, parents(r)=[] when k=0, otherwise [primary(k-1)]. Group order is successful commit order; emitted_receipt_ids partitions the persistent ledger exactly, with one operation primary first and globally unique receipt IDs within that ledger.
attributes.controls: Zero-duration successes advance the head; failures, save/load, snapshot, duplicate, observation and lawful unreceipted set_state do not. Crossings retain the prior ledger prefix. Caller overrides and intra-commit parent edges are forbidden.

attributes.normative_equation_or_contract: The lifecycle owner checks the complete partition, primary types, content identities, commit backlinks and every primary/auxiliary parent before publication or restored observability. Reject missing, skipped, foreign, forward, self, cyclic, duplicate, nonprimary or extra parents. Content constructors/comparators alone do not establish lineage validity.
attributes.snapshot_policy: The C_OS implementation declares pygrc-c-os-snapshot-v3 with receipt_parent_policy_id and specification_release_id, a complete reference_registry and transition_records. Both identifiers must match the current accepted contract. Historical v1/v2 layouts are explicitly rejected, never guessed, upgraded or silently rehashed. Historical execution remains reconstructible through Git.

attributes.normative_equation_or_contract: Commit rank strictly decreases on parent edges, proving a finite DAG, not an authenticated uninterrupted history. Do not require next source=previous target after lawful unreceipted set_state. Coherent structural rewrites may validate; retained run hashes bind external provenance. Duplicates/forks may share content IDs. Parent changes can change receipt/commit/lifecycle IDs and descendants, not the scientific/reset/event preimages for the same scientific operation.

Enabled compute_observables and successful ordinary-step observable maps always expose abundance, abundance_status and abundance_observation. No admitted definition means exactly null, unavailable_no_admitted_definition, null. Numeric zero means a detector computed zero, not unavailability. Available mode requires v4_abundance_diagnostic for the exact model, admitted release, definition and detector; basin_attributes or specialization alone does not imply it. Failed results and lifecycle methods returning no observables gain no new fields.

Available abundance is a finite nonnegative I-JSON number, never bool; integer counts are safe integers. The closed observation object has exactly definition_id, detector_id, stage, observed_state_digest and model_identity. The admitted versioned family definition owns units, domain, reduction/counting, thresholds and deterministic order. It uniquely resolves under the producing interface/specification release; model_identity alone never implies diagnostic semantics. Read-only observation binds one captured committed state; step observation binds the fully reconstructed prospective target, not the operation source or predictor. Exported observations retain release and definition/detector source context; missing context never defaults to the currently installed release. Incompatible state/profile/graph/context changes invalidate cached observations. No numeric definition is admitted here.

An advertised detector is total over its advertised domain and has an admitted typed error contract. Unsupported declared definitions reject support/admission, never downgrade to unavailable. Failure on an otherwise admitted state is a conformance/programmer error, not a scientific outcome; it raises before sole publication and preserves full prestate, never returning null, zero or stale success. API failure may abort publication, but diagnostic values never control constitutive evolution, admission, solver disposition, sparks or selection. No diagnostic state, trajectory parameter, authoritative history, mutable callback, scientific receipt kind or model/profile identity coordinate is added. Definition/release revisions may leave scientific model identity unchanged. Disabled GRC9V4 delegates exact legacy observable semantics and projects out V4-only fields; no common/V3/GRC9V3 repair or enabled GRC9V4 count is inferred.
